_comment: SOLE-WRITER REGISTER for the neuron graph. Enforced by
'a source/behavior test proves no new ungoverned writer was introduced'.
This is a DEBT REGISTER, not a blessing. It records which modules write to
neurons/neuron_edges TODAY so that a NEW writer cannot appear unnoticed. An
entry here is not an endorsement — several of these predate the action bus
and are candidates for routing through it later. Like cycle_allowlist.json,
the list may only get SHORTER: a module that stops writing must be removed,
or the stale entry would let a future writer inherit its slot.
The third rule this file backs is the strongest and is NOT a list: raw SQL
may never assign an authored-content or lifecycle column. That is true of
the codebase today and nothing enforced it before now. Content, authority,
scope and the supersession lifecycle change only through the ORM and the
action bus, which is where the evidence gates and countersign path live.
